title: The Transmission (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic atmospheric 98bpm pulsing synth bass ethereal vocal layers sparse percussion cosmic clear signal received triumphant
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The transmission came through clean at seventeen past three
A signal so precise it cut the static perfectly
The message was as clear as anything has ever been
The transmission was the clearest thing that I have ever seen

[Pre-Chorus]
Some transmissions come once and they come when you don't expect them
And the whole job of your life is just to not forget them

[Chorus]
The transmission carries everything across the empty space
Between the mind that sent it and the mind that found the place
The transmission is complete — the data made it through
The transmission is the bridge between what I know and you
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
The radio astronomer receives a signal from deep space
And checks the data twice because the math says it's a place
Where something has been purposeful and aimed at this direction
The transmission from the universe awaits your full attention

[Bridge]
There are transmissions in the ordinary day
A conversation, a piece of music, something someone said halfway
Through a sentence that you recognised as something meant for you
The transmission doesn't care about the medium it comes through

[Outro]
The transmission came through clean… received and understood…
That's my boy
